records.title: Hijama on sunnah days: timing, booking and what the clinic offers
records.angle: published availability and honest framing of sunnah timing alongside what the clinic can offer
records.summary: How to check availability around sunnah days, with context on what the clinic publishes and what a reliable Islamic calendar source should confirm.

answer.heading: Check Fresha availability for the dates you want
answer.text: The clinic is open every day and Fresha shows live availability. Whether a particular Islamic date corresponds to a sunnah day is a separate question; check a reliable Islamic calendar source for that confirmation.

sections.heading: What the clinic can confirm about timing
paragraphs: The clinic can confirm that it is open every day and that Fresha shows the next available slots. It does not publish a separate sunnah-day booking route.

sections.heading: Where to find sunnah-day information
paragraphs: Use a reliable Islamic calendar or a knowledgeable scholar to identify the relevant lunar dates. This guide does not calculate those dates or assert which are recommended.
